جَحْمَةٌ The burning, burning brightly or fiercely, blazing, or flaming, of fire; (Ham p. 77;) as also ↓ جَاحِمٌ : (TA:) or vehemence of burning or blazing or flaming: (Bd in xxxvii. 95:) or it is an epithet applied to fire because of its redness [or as meaning red]. (Ham ubi suprà.) ―
-b2- See also جَحِيمٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
